def send(points,dt=.05,cameras=['practice_cam'],note=''):
    global cur,counter,last
    points=np.asarray(points); poses=np.c_[points,np.tile(quat,(len(points),1))]
    counter+=1

    return last

def move(p,speed=.04,hold=.4,cameras=['practice_cam']):
    n=max(1,int(np.ceil(np.linalg.norm(np.asarray(p)-cur)/speed/.05)))
    pts=np.linspace(cur,p,n+1)[1:].tolist()+[p]*int(hold/.05)
    for i in range(0,len(pts),180): send(pts[i:i+180],cameras=cameras)
